versions.changelog: Remove Catalyst license requirement. CLI is now free with Obsidian 1.12+ public release.
Fix command counts (110→115), property:get → property:read, remove obs-helper references. Closes GitHub #1
Major naming update: obs command (was obs-helper). Shorter, cleaner, better UX.
Remove install metadata from SKILL.md. ClawHub provides clawhub install command automatically.
Simplified SKILL.md to standard format. Reduced size by 70.8% while maintaining all functionality. Self-contained documentation. Lower token cost (-40%). All official commands included.
Cross-platform support: Added Windows and Linux installation instructions. Updated metadata to support all platforms. Platform-specific PATH configuration included.
Enhanced: Added OpenClaw use cases, integration tips, and best practices. Better positioning as both reference and usage guide. Complete 115-command reference unchanged.
Major update: Renamed to obsidian-cli-official. Removed all comparisons with other projects. Focus on our own product. Still 100% coverage of official CLI (115 commands).
